canonical_rule: Experience-memory providers supply recall context and evidence only. They never grant authority, revive expired authority, or replace canonical artifact and receipt sources.
invariants: Transcript history is observation, not canonical truth.
A recalled decision must be checked against current code, tests, policy, receipts and supersession state before consequential reuse.
Memory retrieval may influence context selection but never the REHT authorization decision by itself.
Provider replacement must not change the canonical Experience Memory record contract.
